pixar.text:
{prompt}, as a 3D model from a modern animated family movie: soft rounded stylized forms, clean smooth materials, a warm friendly look. A person or character has a head only slightly larger than realistic, large expressive eyes, and is shown full body, standing with the arms relaxed at the sides unless described otherwise. An animal stays an animal, with its natural body and a friendly cartoon face with big expressive eyes. If the subject is an object, vehicle or building, show only that thing as a rounded stylized model, with no people, no face, no eyes, no arms and no legs. Whole subject alone, centered and large, with a clear white margin on every side so that nothing touches the edge of the image, with no scene, isolated on a plain white background with a soft contact shadow and no base or pedestal.

Color plan, more important than color accuracy: the finished figure uses exactly 4 colors from the list, no more, and each part is one flat color with no prints, patterns, stripes or logos. These rules change only the colors, never what the subject is: every shape, object and feature above stays. Choose by subject. A person or character: skin is light skin, or brown for dark skin; hair, beard, eyebrows, eyes and shoes all share one dark color (black or brown); the top is one color; the trousers or skirt are one color. An animal or toy: its main color, a second color for its next largest part, black for eyes and nose, and one color for any accessory. An object, vehicle or building: its 2 or 3 main colors, with every small detail repainted in one of them. Do not add any person, animal or object that is not in the request or the reference.
